_comment: Copy this file to config/users/<username>.json and fill in all fields. Remove all _comment keys before use.

section_targets._comment: Sections render in this order as Section I, II, III, ... Each needs a matching '## Section <numeral>' block in the user profile. min = minimum acceptable papers; do not pad below min with low-quality papers. max = cap per section. title = section header shown in the email.

searches._comment: PubMed searches, each dispatched as a parallel query. Assign a unique single-letter id.
searches.label: <human-readable label for this search>
searches.query: <PubMed query string — do NOT include date filters here; they are appended at runtime>

preprints._comment: Optional. Remove this block to search PubMed only. Fetched by scripts/fetch_preprints.py.

biorxiv._comment: server is biorxiv or medrxiv; category uses the server's category names. Postings are kept only if the title or abstract matches a keyword ('*' is a suffix wildcard), unless keep_all is true.

arxiv._comment: arXiv API search_query syntax (abs:, ti:, cat:, AND, OR, ANDNOT). The submittedDate window is appended at runtime.
